screenSpaceIntent.ringPommel: small oblique edge-on ring immediately outside or touching the screen-right shoulder silhouette
screenSpaceIntent.scabbard: fully sheathed and mostly or completely hidden behind the capsule; no isolated lower fragment
screenSpaceIntent.continuity: ring short grip and optional throat cue form one connected shoulder-side object
screenSpaceIntent.holdingPaw: screen-right far paw behind core; only compact outer paw arc may remain visible
screenSpaceIntent.freePaw: screen-left near paw behind core; compact outer arc only and no equipment contact
screenSpaceIntent.feet: two compact rear paws directly attached at baseline without leg segments
